description: Chaos Commerce checkout. Normalizes any cart (even an empty or garbage one), adds absurd fees, tries up to three flaky payment processors and falls back to an IOU, reserves inventory and picks a carrier in parallel, then confirms the order. Every path ends in a confirmed order; no step depends on an external worker.
name: chaos_checkout
